blurry.instructions: state has a short description and one screenshot of a single image as it appears on a website, captured at the real device pixel density. Ignore page text outside the photo. Does the image look blurry or soft, as if a small image was enlarged: faces, hands, edges or fine text are smeared rather than crisp? Intentional soft backgrounds, fades and gradients are not blur.

compression.instructions: Does the image show compression damage: blocky squares, smeared detail on faces or skin, ringing halos around edges, color blotches or posterized color bands in smooth areas?

sharpness.instructions: How sharp and clean does this image look on a modern phone or laptop screen?
